notes: If Control Hub can't start, it now says why on screen (and saves it in hub.log), instead of not opening at all.
Updates no longer get stuck on "the file is being used by another process".
New look for Control Hub: Overview with cockpit-style status lights, and Windows 11's own font and icons.
New Backup page: back up everything to one file, optionally with your logins (protected by a password).
Automatic backup every week (newest 5 kept), to OneDrive if you use it.
Restore a whole backup, or just an earlier panel layout.
